newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Wheelabrator Q2 net, share fall.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Wheelabrator Q2 net, share fall.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTES: Q2 1997 results include $18.3 million of construction revenue related to the retrofit of Pinellas County, Florida's trash-to-energy facility and construction of a biosolids compost facility for Burlington County, N.J.

Q2 97 results also include Wheelabrator's indirect equity interest in a second quarter charge taken by OHM Corp. Rust International, which is 40 pct owned by Wheelabrator, owns 37 percent of OHM. The charge reduced the company's equity earnings by about $4.8 million, or $0.03 a share.
Wheelabrator also completed the sale of its water business during the quarter and recognized a $1.2 million after tax gain on the divestiture.
Full co name is Wheelabrator Technologies Inc.
